verdict.rationale: PostHog documents percentage rollouts behind feature flags, experiment metrics, and programmatic flag management. The evidence only describes a human watching the rollout and turning the flag off manually. Nothing shows metric-guarded rollouts that detect a regression and roll back automatically. Using the API or CI to build such login yourself is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
